meta.title: Nightform
meta.author: Vincenzo (Digital Dynamite, Lethargy)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Nightform by Digital Dynamite, Lethargy (2026-04-05). A 64K intro that placed 4th in the PC 64K intro competition at Revision 2026. Music credited to Vincenzo on Demozoo. 120 BPM, 2:34, 25 tracks, 2092 notes. Instruments: 2 Falcon (FM synth), 9 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 3 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 5 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 7 Scissor, 7 Leveller, 2 Crusher, 6 Echo, 3 Smasher, 2 Chamber, 3 Twister, 3 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.03 dB loudness and at most 0.92 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
